decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - A Conservation Area type roof lights, measuring 800mm by 700mm, which is flush fitting with the proposed roof tiles, shall be fitted to the roof slopes at the positions herewith approved and retained when replaced.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side (east) elevation wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Infromative
As the proposed side extension comes in close contact to, or make use of, the sidewall of adjacent 57 Burlington Lane, the written consent of the owner of 57 Burlington Lane is required as part of a party wall notice/agreement.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension to existing house.
